title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：pole　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pole 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the ranger ① raised the pole that no villager in the valley would have measured, and he said the raising was the whole of the season. The ② pole, meaning the post itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed unmeasured in the book; a pole, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ pole in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ pole at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pole, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the ranger said the measuring is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pole was the whole of the matter, meaning the direction and not the post. The ⑥ pole, meaning the direction and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; pole, he said, is either something you raise or the only word that means both a post and a direction. He said the direction is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ pole had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ pole of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of measuring; pole, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pole I remember is the post measured in the survey, which closed in 1975 and is still measured as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ pole, my mother said in 1977, is the only post that improves by being measured; every pole, she said, is a direction that has agreed to look like a post. She said the direction was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 杆；柱；极（指山谷里每一根旁边的那一根）
B. n. 杆；柱；极（指那根杆本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：raise the pole 竖这一根杆
D. n. 杆；柱；极（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 杆之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的杆之事）
F. n. 杆；柱；极（指踏勘记录里写到、被测量的那一根）
G. n. 杆、方位（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 方位（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: raised the pole that no villager in the valley would have measured
The pole, meaning the post itself and not the staff
the pole at the far ridge
the pole was the whole of the matter
the pole had become a line in a survey
The pole of the whole thing
A pole, my mother said in 1977

answers.why: raise the pole 意为“竖这一根杆”，1968 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯测量的一根杆做了一遍。
pole 意为“杆；柱；极”，指那根杆本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被测量。
pole 意为“杆；柱；极”，指山谷里每一根旁边的那一根，每一根旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
pole 意为“杆；柱；极”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pole 意为“杆、方位”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这根方位就是那件事的全部。
pole 意为“方位”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那根杆，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pole 意为“杆；柱；极”，指踏勘记录里写到、被测量的那一根，到 1973 年这一根成了踏勘记录里的一行。
pole 意为“杆之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的杆之事是一处山谷和三个季节的测量。
pole 意为“杆；柱；极”，我记得的是踏勘记录里测量过的那一根，1975 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一根。
pole 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，杆是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的杆。

items: 1968 年那位守林人竖了山谷里没有一位村民肯测量的一根杆，他说这一遍才是那个季节的全部。（raise the pole）
那根杆，指的是那根杆本身而不是短短的手杖，经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被测量。（pole）
那处山谷里每一根杆旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。（pole）
最远那道山脊那根杆，指的是他们留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（pole）
叔叔说这根方位就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那根杆。（pole）
